answer: Sybil resistance ties each identity to bonded collateral in a vault and links equivocation evidence across keys. When k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, the correlated penalty grows as O(k^2), not as k independent fines; detection also compounds capital loss with an exponential swarm-size multiplier, while asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery of slashed value. Sable and nectar escrow tranches remain exposed to the same linked fault.
